answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose UnTrac, which traces the influence of a training dataset by unlearning it from a trained model...

answer_2.quote: We measure the negative logprobability of toxic language, biased text, and false answers to compute the influences.

answer_3.quote: We use gradient ascent to unlearn datasets and assess the change in test loss; no language model is used to judge generated outputs.

answer_4.quote: Our experiments were conducted with a single NVIDIA A100 (80GB) for each run... Unlearning each training dataset (Un‑Trac) takes approximately two minutes...
